format: Silent English-captioned walkthrough made from real browser screenshots, not a continuous screen recording.
source: Authorized Panta live-key reads through the local viewer. No credential is in the video.

slides.title: A read-only research workspace
slides.caption: The API key stays on the local server. Researchers review prices, rules and evidence without trading or connecting a wallet.

slides.title: Discover markets with Panta pagination
slides.caption: The approved live key returned 40 markets across two pages. Catalog rows can omit titles and prices; missing data is shown explicitly.

slides.title: Fetch a market detail on demand
slides.caption: This detail returned the Big Brother Naija question, timestamps and independent YES / NO quotes. Prices reflect the captured observation.

slides.title: Make missing resolution wording visible
slides.caption: Panta did not return resolution wording for this market. The viewer explains that it cannot assess absent rules or verify the outcome.

slides.title: Inspect the returned trade tape
slides.caption: The API returned nine trade records. Amounts are preserved as received, with no guessed unit conversion or complete-history claim.

slides.title: Search the pages already loaded
slides.caption: A fetched detail title enriches its catalog row. Search applies to loaded markets, including available titles, identifiers and categories.

slides.title: Compare two observations and export
slides.caption: Two fetched markets were exported with mode=live and synthetic=false. Null quotes stay unavailable; observation times remain visible.

slides.title: Verified integration, clear limits
slides.caption: This prototype has no claimed customers, revenue or award. Next steps are resolution-metadata validation and research with actual users.
